extracted.intended_audience: literate readers of The Spectator; general early-18th-century public interested in manners, morality, and social advice
extracted.subtask_description: Producing short moral and social essays in the Spectator tradition — concise reflections on manners, love, marriage, needlework, and human nature that blend anecdote, classical allusion, and polite satire. Useful as a subtask label for composing or analyzing periodical essays of early 18th-century style.
